hints.sentence: A user held out of a feature group still gets result pages from the cache every user shares, so an ablation test measures only part of what the group is worth.
A value is served for its validity period after its source fails and returns only at its entity's next refresh, so the share of sources failing is not the share of sessions served the default.
The ablation tests withhold a group from the ranking model only, and some groups are also read by a service that shows the user something and loses it in the same hours.
